i.norm: Verifies that HTML entity escaping and unescaping are case-sensitive: the uppercase form (e.g. {@code Ü}) and the lowercase form (e.g. {@code ü}) map to different characters, and only entities with the correct casing are recognised.
The extended escape mode (plus an ASCII charset, which forces non-ASCII characters to be escaped) preserves the distinction between the uppercase and lowercase entity names for U-umlaut.

Unescaping decodes each entity back to its character. "Ü" and "ü" resolve to the distinct upper/lower U-umlaut characters, and both the semicolon-terminated "&" and the legacy bare "&AMP" forms resolve to "&".
